title: Fatal: prop:wd/prop:rev reduction '* maps Dr(M) to Dr(M*)' is false

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Concrete error in the current solution.tex** (`prop:wd` proof and reused in `prop:rev`).

Both `prop:wd` (well-definedness, $w^\perp\in\cW^{\Dr}(M)$) and `prop:rev` (order-reversal) are justified by the structural claim:

> "ordinary valuated duality $\theta\mapsto\theta^*$ sends a valuated quotient of $\underline M$ to a valuated quotient of $\underline{M}^*=\underline{M^*}$, i.e. it maps $\Dr(M)$ to $\Dr(M^*)$ and reverses order ... $\perp$ supplies an order-preserving identification $\Dr(M^*)\cong\Dr(M)$."

This is **false as stated**:

1. $\Dr(M)$ = valuated **quotients** of $\underline M$: $\underline M\onto\theta$. By `fact:dual` ($\mu\onto\nu\Rightarrow\nu^*\onto\mu^*$), dualizing $\underline M\onto\theta$ gives $\theta^*\onto(\underline M)^*=\underline{M^*}$. So $\underline{M^*}$ is a **quotient of** $\theta^*$ — i.e. $\theta^*$ sits *above* $\underline{M^*}$, not below it. Membership in $\Dr(M^*)$ requires $\underline{M^*}\onto\theta^*$, the opposite relation.

2. Rank check: $\underline M$ has rank $r$, $\theta$ has rank $k\le r$, so $\theta^*$ has rank $n-k\ge n-r=\rk(M^*)$. Every element of $\Dr(M^*)$ has rank $\le n-r$. Hence $\theta^*\notin\Dr(M^*)$ whenever $k<r$.

So $*$ maps $\Dr(M)$ to (the order-reversal of) $\{$tropical linear spaces **containing** $\Trop(M^*)\}$, which is **not** $\Dr(M^*)$. The subsequent "order-preserving identification $\Dr(M^*)\cong\Dr(M)$ via $\perp$, compatible with flat-coordinates" is therefore between the wrong objects, and is in any case only verified on examples ($U_{n,n},U_{2,n},F_7$ with values in $\{0,1,2\}$). The key equality $\widehat{\theta^*}=\widehat\theta\circ\perp$ (after relabeling) and "$w\circ\perp$ is again a valid flat-coordinate" are never derived. The author concedes this in `rmk:honest`.

**Consequence:** $\Phi$ is not shown to be a well-defined self-map of $\Dr(M)$, nor order-reversing. This is the deepest, fatal gap and overlaps the abstract issues prob-08-2/3/4; this issue records the *specific incorrect reduction* in the current attempt so it is not reused.

**Fix direction:** abandon the duality reduction; prove the intrinsic lattice-Plücker cryptomorphism (prob-08-2) and its $\perp$-invariance (prob-08-3/4) directly, following the template that already works in `prop:ext`.
